mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scenario_replay (batch_id, algorithm_version, seed, base_time, line_count) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{version}, #{seed}, #{baseTime}, #{count})
mapper.select: SELECT b.scenario_code, b.file_sha256, r.algorithm_version, r.seed, r.base_time, r.line_count FROM import_batch b LEFT JOIN scenario_replay r ON r.batch_id = b.id WHERE b.id = #{batchId}
